text:
Anna (PM): quick ask — we need a more defensible per-route cost view in the console. Specifically: token-level cost + an explicit line for cache savings, and the ability to break it down by model variant (fp16/8q/quantized). want this for billing slices and routing decisions.

Mike (Eng): agree. current dashboards show gross token spend but not the savings from prefix/KV caching. that makes per-route unit economics misleading.

Jess (Data): can we define the metric set first? my proposal: raw_token_cost = sum(tokens_in + tokens_out) * model_rate; cache_savings = estimated_saved_tokens * model_rate; net_cost = raw_token_cost - cache_savings. aggregate by route_id, model_tag, and day.

Sam (UX): UI idea: show a bar with three segments: gross token cost, cache savings (negative), and net cost. allow toggles: allocate cache savings by (a) proportional to tokens, (b) proportional to responses, (c) manual rule. quick mock available.

Mike (Eng): for attribution we need request-level flags: route_id, model_version, tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_hit boolean, cache_saved_tokens. are we already emitting cache_saved_tokens? I think runtime emits cache_hit but not saved_tokens.

Nora (Platform): runtime emits kv_cache_hit and prefix_cache_hit counts per req; saved token estimate would be added in router if we know matched prefix lengths. small change but will bump ingestion volume slightly.

Jess (Data): pipeline steps: 1) add cache_saved_tokens to events; 2) nightly batch to compute model_rate per variant (USD/token or USD/1k tokens); 3) join -> per-route daily aggregates. SQL sketch:
```
SELECT route_id, model_tag, date_trunc('day', ts) AS day,
  SUM(tokens_in + tokens_out) AS raw_tokens,
  SUM(cache_saved_tokens) AS saved_tokens,
  SUM((tokens_in + tokens_out) * model_rate) AS raw_cost,
  SUM(cache_saved_tokens * model_rate) AS cache_savings,
  SUM((tokens_in + tokens_out) * model_rate) - SUM(cache_saved_tokens * model_rate) AS net_cost
FROM events
WHERE ts >= '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1,2,3;
```

Liam (Finance): thumbs up on net_cost. for chargeback we need conservative allocations — prefer method (a) proportional to raw_tokens for now. also need exportable CSV with per-route daily net_unit_cost = net_cost / responses.

Sam (UX): follow-up: add a per-route drilldown with a small histogram of token distribution (p50/p90) and a toggle to switch allocation method so product owners can experiment. also show model variant split (pie).

Mike (Eng): implementation concerns: computing model_rate per variant requires stable price table. for dedicated/private customers rates differ. add dimension `customer_pricing_tier` and let joins pick per-tenant rates.

Anna (PM): good call. our product requirement: default to platform rates for public, but surface per-tenant overrides. rollout plan: start with read-only dashboard behind feature-flag, then enable CSV export, then add chargeback API.

Nora (Platform): note — the feature-flag will be a config on console service. will inject telemetry schema change for saved_tokens. estimate +5% event volume. need signoff from infra for retention/storage.

Jess (Data): rough ETA: schema + pipeline changes 2w, aggregation + dashboards 1w, CSV/API 1w. can do a canary for 2 tenants.

Liam (Finance): request: add a column for "accounting_adjustment" so we can apply manual reconciliations for month-end.

Mike (Eng): ack. also suggest adding a simple per-route cache-efficiency metric: cache_saved_tokens / raw_tokens (0..1). easy to compute and useful for routing policy tuning.

Sam (UX): UI note: show that metric inline with a tooltip: "cache efficiency = fraction of tokens avoided by caching". :sparkles:

deploy-bot: rollout cost-dashboard-v1 flag turned on for canary orgs at 1791234600

Anna (PM): next actions: Nora to open infra ticket for event schema change; Jess to add pipeline spec; Sam to post mock; Mike to estimate engineering hours. I'll collate and send to stakeholders. :+1:
